hook.name: TTTHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for TTT/ETH pools launched by the TenThousandTokens factory. Applies a flat 1% fee on every swap; on buys, fee tokens are swapped back to ETH and forwarded to a FeeSplitter. During the first 15 minutes after launch, if the pool has nftOnlyPeriod enabled, only holders of the original TenThousandTokens NFT collection may buy.
